selection: Sound references for all grapheme groups. Whole-word pronunciation uses en-GB Sonia; consonants and some vowels are general IPA reference clips.

clips.title: Open-mid front unrounded vowel.ogg
clips.author: Terfili (current recording); Denelson83 (original uploader)
clips.changes: Extracted 0.020–0.220 s from single-vowel demonstration; 2 ms edge fades; gain x0.563; MP3 conversion. CC BY-SA 3.0 applies where specified.
clips.notes: IPA [ɛ] reference, corresponding to dictionary phoneme /e/ in friend.

clips.usage: Standalone /i:/ reference for read ea and meet ee; not a general rule for all ea/ee spellings.
clips.review: User accepted isolated vowel and complete read teaching audition, 2026-11-03; professional phonetic review pending.

retiredReference.notes: UK recording of letter E, used only as an acoustically matching /iː/ reference, not as a rule that all e letters have that sound.
